member.name: DbType

member.value: This is the DbType of the value provided to the database when the query is executed. The default value is AnsiString.

member.name: ParameterName
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the database parameter.
member.value: The specifying the name of the parameter.

member.name: Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the size of the parameter, for those scenarios which require it.
member.value: A indicating the size of the parameter.
member.remarks: The default value is 0, and not all database parameter types or use-cases require specifying the size of the database parameter. String and Decimal are the main culprits.

member.name: Scale
member.summary: Gets or sets the scale of the database parameter.
member.value: A specifying the scale of the database parameter.
member.remarks: It is often required to specify scale for Decimal and similar types.

member.name: Precision
member.summary: Gets or sets the precision of the database parameter.
member.value: A specifying the precision of the database parameter.
member.remarks: It is often required to specify precision for Decimal and similar types.

member.name: SourceColumn
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the source column mapped to the DataSet and used for loading or returning the Value.
member.value: The name of the source column mapped to the DataSet. The default is an empty string.

member.name: SourceColumnNullMapping
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether the source column is nullable. This allows DbCommandBuilder to correctly generate Update statements for nullable columns.
